CAS — 126222-34-2. ATC — C09XA01. ATC Vet — QC09XA01. Profile Remikiren inhibits the actions of renin and thus prevents the con- version of angiotensinogen into angiotensin I. It is orally active and has been investigated in the management of hypertension and heart failure. ◊ A number of renin antagonists have been investigated as spe- cific inhibitors of the renin-angiotensin system.1,2 Remikiren is a nonpeptide that is active intravenously and orally, but it is report- ed to have a very low oral bioavailability. 1.
